SELECT funding_toptier_agency_name, sum(try_cast(obligation_sum AS double)) AS obligated FROM govblock_awards.usaspending_db_rpt_covid_faba_spending WHERE spending_level = 'subtier_agency' AND funding_toptier_agency_name IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10

SELECT year, qtr, qtrly_estabs FROM govblock_labor.qcew_quarterly WHERE area_fips = '06037' AND industry_code = '722511' AND cast(year AS varchar) = '2024' ORDER BY qtr
Which cities are home to the most SEC filers?
SELECT cityba, stprba, count(DISTINCT cik) AS companies FROM govblock_sec.sec_fsds_sub GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 3 DESC LIMIT 10

Which utilities sold the most electricity to industrial customers in 2020?

SELECT column02 AS utility, column06 AS state, try_cast(sales_2 AS double) AS industrial_mwh FROM govblock_energy.eia861_sales_ult_cust_sheet_states WHERE column00 = '2020' AND column03 = 'A' ORDER BY 3 DESC LIMIT 10
How have pedestrian deaths changed over the last ten years on record?

SELECT death_yr AS year, count(*) AS pedestrians_killed FROM govblock_vehicles.fars_person WHERE per_typ = '5' AND inj_sev = '4' AND try_cast(death_yr AS integer) BETWEEN 2000 AND 2100 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1 DESC LIMIT 10
Which states enrolled the most public school students in 2024-25?

SELECT statename, sum(try_cast(student_count AS double)) AS students FROM govblock_education.ccd_sch_052 WHERE school_year = '2024-2025' AND total_indicator = 'Education Unit Total' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many facilities reported releasing PFAS chemicals in 2022?
SELECT count(DISTINCT _2_trifd) AS facilities FROM govblock_environment.tri_basic WHERE _48_pfas = 'YES' AND cast(_1_year AS varchar) = '2022'
Which kinds of federal cases fill the docket archive: civil, criminal, bankruptcy or other?

SELECT CASE federal_dn_case_type WHEN 'cv' THEN 'Civil' WHEN 'cr' THEN 'Criminal' WHEN 'bk' THEN 'Bankruptcy' WHEN 'mj' THEN 'Magistrate judge' WHEN 'mc' THEN 'Miscellaneous' WHEN 'ap' THEN 'Adversary proceeding' ELSE federal_dn_case_type END AS case_type, count(*) AS dockets FROM govblock_courts.dockets WHERE federal_dn_case_type IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
What is the average three-bedroom fair market rent across Florida's counties?
SELECT avg(try_cast(fmr3 AS double)) AS avg_three_bedroom FROM govblock_housing.hud_fmr_fmrs_sheet_excel_data WHERE state_alpha = 'FL'
Which states have the highest average residential electricity rate by ZIP code?
SELECT state, avg(try_cast(res_rate AS double)) AS dollars_per_kwh FROM govblock_solar.urdb_zip_rates WHERE state IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many data series does the national accounts register list?
SELECT count(*) AS n FROM govblock_economy.bea_nipa_seriesregister
Which companies hold the most cellular licences?
SELECT column07 AS licensee, count(DISTINCT column04) AS call_signs FROM govblock_consumer.fcc_uls_l_en WHERE uls_file = 'l_cell.zip' AND column05 = 'L' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How did U.S. crude oil production change from January 2010 to January 2024?
SELECT period, try_cast(value AS double) AS thousand_barrels_per_day FROM govblock_energy.eia_pet_data WHERE series_id = 'PET.MCRFPUS2.M' AND period IN ('201001', '202401') ORDER BY 1
How are transmission line segments spread across voltage classes?
SELECT replace(volt_class, '"', ''), count(*) AS n FROM govblock_siting.hifld_electric_power_transmission_lines WHERE replace(volt_class, '"', '') IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How much did federal campaigns spend on advertising in 2022?
SELECT sum(try_cast(transaction_amt AS double)) AS spent FROM govblock_fec.operating_expenditures WHERE cast(rpt_yr AS varchar) = '2022' AND upper(purpose) LIKE '%ADVERTIS%'
How do EPA-regulated facilities stand on compliance?
SELECT fac_compliance_status, count(*) AS n FROM govblock_environment.echo_echo_exporter WHERE fac_compliance_status IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How much did Medicare Part D pay for Eliquis prescriptions written in Florida?
Medicare Part D Prescribers By Provider And Drug
SELECT sum(try_cast(tot_drug_cst AS double)) AS cost FROM govblock_health.medicare_part_d_prescribers_by_provider_and_drug WHERE brnd_name = 'Eliquis' AND prscrbr_state_abrvtn = 'FL'
Which metro areas have the most banks headquartered in them?
SELECT cbsa_metro_name, count(*) AS banks FROM govblock_finance.fdic_institutions WHERE cast(active AS varchar) = '1' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
Do federal workers or private workers earn more per week in Washington, D.C.?
Jobs and Wages by County and Industry

SELECT own_code, avg_wkly_wage FROM govblock_labor.qcew_quarterly WHERE area_fips = '11001' AND industry_code = '10' AND cast(year AS varchar) = '2024' AND cast(qtr AS varchar) = '1' AND cast(own_code AS varchar) IN ('1', '5')
Which European countries get the most out of their onshore wind on average?
SELECT country, avg(try_cast(cf AS double)) AS avg_capacity_factor FROM govblock_energy.wind_entsoe_pecd_pecd_country_onshore GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How far, on average, are calculated hydration free energies from measured ones in the solvation benchmark?
SELECT avg(abs(expt - calc)) AS average FROM govblock_chemistry.moleculenet_sampl
Which companies sold the most electricity into the New York ISO in 2024?

SELECT seller_company_name, sum(try_cast(standardized_quantity AS double)) AS mwh FROM govblock_energy.ferceqr_transactions WHERE year_quarter LIKE '2024%' AND point_of_delivery_balancing_authority = 'NYIS' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How did average hourly load in New York City change from 2005 to 2023?

SELECT substr(time_stamp, 7, 4) AS year, avg(try_cast(integrated_load AS double)) AS average_mw FROM govblock_solar.nyiso_zonal_load_hourly_palintegrated WHERE name LIKE 'N.Y.C%' AND substr(time_stamp, 7, 4) IN ('2005', '2023') GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
Which states have built the most solar photovoltaic generating capacity?

SELECT state, round(sum(mw)) AS solar_mw FROM (SELECT state, plant_code, generator_id, max(try_cast(nameplate_capacity_mw AS double)) AS mw FROM govblock_energy.eia860_generator_y_sheet_operable WHERE technology = 'Solar Photovoltaic' GROUP BY 1, 2, 3) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
